mapper.select: SELECT tdm36_company_id FROM tdm36_role_report WHERE tdm36_role_report_id = #{roleReportId}

SELECT tdm36_role_report_id AS role_report_id, tdm36_company_id AS company_id, TO_CHAR(tdm36_board_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS board_open_date, TO_CHAR(tdm36_allc_std_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS allc_std_date, TO_CHAR(tdm36_report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_date, tdm36_board_open_loc AS board_open_loc, tdm36_memb_tot_cnt AS memb_tot_cnt, tdm36_memb_attend_cnt AS memb_attend_cnt, tdm36_board_open_agenda AS board_open_agenda, tdm36_memb_yes_nm AS memb_yes_name, tdm36_upd_nm AS upd_name, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm36_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str, tdm36_appr_id AS appr_id, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name FROM tdm36_role_report LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm36_appr_id WHERE tdm36_company_id = #{companyId}
AND tdm36_board_open_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND CAST(#{closeDate} AS date)
AND apr01_status_cd IN ('10','20','99')
ORDER BY tdm36_role_report_id DESC

WITH list_tdm36 AS ( SELECT tdm36_role_report_id , tdm36_company_id , tdm36_board_open_date , tdm36_allc_std_date , COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(tdm36_allc_std_date) FROM tdm36_role_report WHERE tdm36_company_id = a.tdm36_company_id AND tdm36_allc_std_date < a.tdm36_allc_std_date), to_date('20200101','yyyymmdd')) bf_allc_std_date , tdm36_rpt_cover_file_id , tdm36_rpt_overview_file_id , tdm36_rpt_ceo_cfrm_file_id , tdm36_rpt_board_vote_file_id FROM tdm36_role_report a WHERE tdm36_role_report_id = #{roleReportId} ) SELECT 1 AS role_report_id , 1 AS seq , 0 AS sub_seq , '표지' AS rpt_title , '' AS rpt_sub_title , 'MK_FSS_COVER' AS rd_code , null AS rd_code2 , tdm36_rpt_cover_file_id AS relate_file_id , 0 AS relate_appr_id , '00' AS relate_appr_status_code FROM list_tdm36 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 2, 0 , '붙임1(책무구조도 제출개요)' , '본문' , 'MK_FSS_OVERVIEW' , null , tdm36_rpt_overview_file_id , 0 , '00' FROM list_tdm36 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 3, 0 , '붙임1(책무구조도 제출개요)' , '첨부-대표이사 확인서' , 'MK_FSS_CEO_CFRM' , null , tdm36_rpt_ceo_cfrm_file_id , 0 , '00' FROM list_tdm36 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 4, 0 , '붙임1(책무구조도 제출개요)' , '첨부-이사회 결의서' , 'MK_FSS_BOARD' , null , tdm36_rpt_board_vote_file_id , 0 , '00' FROM list_tdm36 UNION ALL SELECT tdm31_role_desc_id , 5 , CASE WHEN tdm20_role_type ='A' THEN 1 WHEN tdm20_role_type ='C' THEN 2 WHEN tdm20_role_type ='B' THEN 3 WHEN tdm20_role_type ='D' THEN 4 WHEN tdm20_role_type ='E' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END , '붙임2(책무기술서)' , tdm20_role_nm||'('||tdm01_person_nm||')' , null , 'ROLE_DESC' , 0 , tdm31_appr_id , ( SELECT COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '00') FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = tdm31_appr_id ) FROM (SELECT tdm31_role_desc_id, tdm20_role_type, tdm20_role_nm, tdm01_person_nm , tdm31_appr_id , row_number() over (partition by tdm31_person_id order by tdm36_allc_std_date desc, tdm31_reg_date desc) seq_by_person FROM tdm31_role_desc INNER JOIN list_tdm36 ON tdm31_company_id = tdm36_company_id INNER JOIN Tdm30_role_allc ON tdm31_role_allc_id= tdm30_role_allc_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm30_role_id = tdm20_role_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm01_hr ON tdm31_person_id = tdm01_person_id WHERE 1=1 AND tdm31_appr_id IS NOT NULL AND tdm30_start_date <= tdm36_allc_std_date AND coalesce( tdm30_end_date, tdm36_allc_std_date +1 ) >= tdm36_allc_std_date ) a WHERE seq_by_person =1 UNION ALL SELECT tdm32_role_digm_id , 6 , 0 , '붙임3(책무체계도)' , '' , null , 'ROLE_DIGM' , 0 , tdm32_appr_id , ( SELECT COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '00') FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = tdm32_appr_id ) FROM tdm32_role_digm INNER JOIN list_tdm36 ON tdm32_company_id = tdm36_company_id WHERE tdm32_appr_id IS NOT NULL AND tdm32_allc_std_date > bf_allc_std_date AND tdm32_allc_std_date <= tdm36_allc_std_date UNION ALL SELECT 7, 7, 0 , '참조1(다운로드)' , 'FINES 등록정보' , 'MK_FINES' , null , 0 , 0 , '00' ORDER BY seq, sub_seq, role_report_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm36_role_report ( tdm36_role_report_id, tdm36_company_id, tdm36_board_open_date, tdm36_allc_std_date, tdm36_report_date , tdm36_board_open_loc, tdm36_memb_tot_cnt, tdm36_memb_attend_cnt, tdm36_board_open_agenda, tdm36_memb_yes_nm , tdm36_upd_nm, tdm36_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{roleReportId}, #{companyId}, #{boardOpenDate}, #{allcStdDate}, #{reportDate} , #{boardOpenLoc}, #{membTotCnt}, #{membAttendCnt}, #{boardOpenAgenda}, #{membYesName} , #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
